summary: Run the POSIX lane's consumer-install smoke through scripts/smoke-install.mjs instead of re-spelling it inline, per *The fix lands at the mechanism*

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: ci.yml's Consumer-install smoke invokes the shared script and re-spells none of its steps; the Consumer type-resolution gate finds the consumer dir and tarball the script left standing.
tests: the CI consumer-install smoke runs scripts/smoke-install.mjs rather than re-spelling its steps
notes: The inline copy is why the chain-load verb drifted on one side only. It re-spells pack / init / type=module / --no-save install / chain+prompt fixtures, and omits the script's shim --version and exports-subpath steps, so POSIX acceptance is weaker than windows under an equivalent name. Blocker: the type-resolution gate reuses $RUNNER_TEMP/flume-consumer and the tarball, which the script deletes with its scratch. The existing CI verb-agreement case is superseded once the copy is gone.
